project.title: Microbial community profiling of wastewater treatment processes
project.description: To identify the core microbial constituents in wastewater treatment processes, comprehensive microbial community profiling based on 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing was performed.
project.center_name: Microbial Ecology and Technology Research Group, Bioproduction Research Institute, National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST)
